component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() colors = ["0x3060C0FF", "0xC03060FF", "0x30A060FF", "0xA08020FF", "0x8040C0FF"] titles = ["Big Hits", "Action", "Drama", "The Grid", "", "", ""] counts = [15, 15, 15, 4, 4, 4, 3] root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for r = 0 to counts.count() - 1 row = root.createChild("ContentNode") row.title = titles[r] for c = 0 to counts[r] - 1 item = row.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = "R" + r.toStr() + " C" + c.toStr() item.hdPosterUrl = colors[c mod colors.count()] end for end for rows = m.top.findNode("rows") rows.content = root rows.observeField("rowItemFocused", "onRowItemFocused") rows.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onRowItemFocused() f = m.top.findNode("rows").rowItemFocused print "PROBE|rowItemFocused=" + f[0].toStr() + "," + f[1].toStr() end sub
